answer: Reputation Decay Collateral Curve: each identity must post collateral that decays on a schedule unless renewed by verified work. Fresh identities start at a low ceiling, so creating many is cheap once but each only earns a tiny nebula of trust-weighted credit. An attacker wanting influence must either mature identities slowly or pay escalating renewal collateral, like feeding an ember that dims without fuel. Sybil cost scales with desired aggregate weight, not headcount. A zephyr of activity on one identity cannot subsidize a thousand dormant ones,
